method: Hash pinned complete Ergo archive and its uncompressed Windows DLL. Enumerate every non-directory org/rocksdb/**/*.class ZIP entry including util/; reject duplicate names. Record all 253 uncompressed class hashes.

Parse class-file constant pool, access flags, class name, fields, methods and attributes; select ACC_NATIVE 0x0100 method_info entries. Preserve descriptor and ACC_STATIC 0x0008. Check class names against ZIP paths and consume every class file fully. Names/descriptors in this input are ASCII; no general modified-UTF8 parser claim.

JNI Java 21 name rules: escape class/name, form short symbol, then long symbol from the argument descriptor only; search short before long. Record missing declarations, distinct used symbols and every unreferenced export. Check native overload groups for a short symbol that would alias multiple descriptors.

Parse the pinned DLL PE32+ section/export-name directory as bytes. Confirm 1603 unique names and the prior recorded sorted-name digest. Compare with all 1524 names in the retained hosted dumpbin report, rejecting duplicate names. No DLL load or Java execution.
Export digests hash sorted ASCII names joined by LF with final LF. Native declaration digest hashes sorted class TAB method TAB descriptor TAB static-or-instance rows joined by LF with final LF.
Inspect the exact-commit source for missing bindings and compression settings; source findings do not authenticate the discarded build binaries or prove runtime reachability.
limitations: Static symbol-name coverage only: no return-type/calling-convention, callback, ABI or semantic guarantee. Short names do not encode argument descriptors; long names do not encode returns.
The candidate DLL and generated JAR were discarded. The retained report cannot substitute for inspecting actual retained output and its complete Java linkage.
Four newly missing native declarations and three shared gaps prevent a blanket Java API compatibility claim. No general Ergo call-graph, reflection or runtime coverage is established.

LZ4 export removal plus pinned compression-free configuration does not establish all features of the published DLL, absence of every embedded codec in a future candidate, or compatibility with arbitrary existing databases.

No build dispatch, library substitution, module-policy relaxation, volume allocation, public peer connection or database-control retry. Exact native version/hash, WinSxS and 1-second sampling gates remain.
